description: Stairfurb (trading name of Homespace Installations Ltd · company no. 09287041). Specialists in bespoke staircase refurbishment kits — 'The simplest way to transform your staircase without replacing it.' Manufacture balustrade kits (glass and spindle) to refurbish existing staircases. Outdoor balustrade options (wire · framed glass · frameless glass). Professional delivery with DIY installation support.
services: Outdoor balustrades (wire · framed glass · frameless glass)

refacing_evidence.summary: Website headline: 'Staircase Refurbishment Kits. Made By Us. Fitted By You.' Explicit statements: 'We specialise in bespoke staircase refurbishment kits' and 'We manufacture balustrade kits, to refurbish existing staircases.' Focus is refurbishment WITHOUT replacing the existing staircase.
